title: AF Activation in Kenya
body: Could you please activate AF calibration for watches and in Health for those in Kenya.
author: Snajmi

title: Feature Request: Home Screen/Stack Widget for Health App
body: The Health app has changed how I monitor my health state and most importantly, how I track my medication especially when I am sick. I would like request a home or stack widget for the app that tracks things like medication, step counts, heart rates, etc so that it makes it easier to monitor some of you health details right from your home screen.
author: Kenneth Murerwa

title: Clutter
body: It’s too cluttered! Too much going on. Create small icons as shortcuts.
author: dmmwose
